flags.message: gemini-baseline, claude-baseline, and codex-baseline each freeze band baseline under sal-v3 for Term 2026, but metrics/statpack.md labels the available segment table sal-v4. Per the evaluation contract, all three evaluations omit segment_base_rate and brier_skill_score and leave base_rate_basis null. A terminal fallback would be invalid because each prediction has a frozen band. Outcome scoring is unaffected.
